reasons.claim: Five eligible species within 250 m. Four have records at 0 m from the polygon edge in 2026 (10 m uncertainty): Hydnellum gracilipes, Hydnellum scabrosum, Tricholoma matsutake and Phellodon secretus (all VU, forest-associated, site-bound fungi; threats include lack of continuity forest and old/large trees). The fifth is Alectoria sarmentosa (VU lichen, 235 m, 2026, 1 m uncertainty). The rubric gives HIGH.

Seven more eligible VU species lie beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, e.g. Aphroditeola olida (322 m) and Sidera lenis (672 m). The tool reports 23 site-bound forest NT species within 1000 m, several at 0 m, such as Hydnellum ferrugineum and Carbonicola anthracophila.
Effort is adequate (96th percentile). The polygon has 42 records from 14 species inside it and 72 records within 250 m. No completed felling overlaps the 7.35 ha polygon.

uncertainties: Records at 0 m are at the polygon edge or inside; the tool output does not say which of them lie inside the polygon.
The effort comparison uses a county sample from a short recent window; recording effort at this site may reflect a targeted survey.
Nothing in the tool output describes the stand itself.
not_established: That these species occupy the felling area as it is today, or would be affected by felling.
Absence of records elsewhere does not mean absence of species.
Nothing here says the site is safe to fell or that felling is unlawful.
next_action: Reviewer should map the 2026 records of Hydnellum gracilipes, Hydnellum scabrosum, Tricholoma matsutake and Phellodon secretus against the polygon boundary and survey the stand before felling begins.
